title: Catalyst-free synthesis of 1,2,3-triazole-N-oxide derivatives using tert-butyl nitrite: a novel strategy and synthetic applications

tBuONO-mediated synthesis of triazole-N-oxide using tBuONO as an NO source. EtOH/H2O serves as a green solvent and additive. Triazole N-oxide is used in various synthetic transformations.
